QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out at `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` are also commented out" and "With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` + `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros as the ones controlling whether mutexes/locking are compiled in (the section header and the "Mutexes exist only when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is enabled" statement), which covers the gating-macros item.
